about: Questions a person would actually ask of a repository, with the right answer named
in advance by opening the source -- never by running graph-paat and accepting what it
said. Ten per corpus. `why` records how the answer was decided, so a disputed question
can be re-argued from the same evidence rather than from memory.
An answer is written as `path/to/file.ext:Label`, matching a node in the built graph.
More than one answer is listed only where two symbols are genuinely equally correct --
a library that ships two major versions side by side, for instance -- and the reason
is written into `why`. Every extra answer makes the question easier, so they are rare.
Scored by tests/question_runner.py: is the named answer the FIRST result, and is it in
the top three. Run `python -m tests.question_runner` to see every miss.
